description_en: Known limitations and open QA items for the Book One corpus. Tracked so downstream users do not mistake reference summaries for verified official text.

issues.summary_en: No article has been independently verified against the official Umm Al-Qura Arabic text in this build. Every article's source.official_text_check is 'needs_check'.
Arabic reference summaries are manually reconstructed MSA (the PDF Arabic layer extracts garbled). They are concise reference summaries, not statutory text.
Article 8 must use 第三人 only, never 善意第三人 (Arabic says الغير without a good-faith qualifier). Enforced by validation and tests.
Scope corrected from the PDF's internal '1-15' part title to the unified Book One range 1-34. Enforced by validation.
Article 17 body uses '王国认可的会计准则'; the SOCPA/IFRS explanation lives in translator notes rather than the article body.
